prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: real-time WebGL Saturn ring dust fog sprite atlas, one square 512x512 RGBA bitmap containing exactly four isolated sprites in a 2x2 equal grid (each cell 256x256), no visible grid.
Primary request: four distinct wispy fine ice-dust haze puffs, natural irregular feathery edges and layered turbulent translucent interiors. Delicate drifting space dust, not rocks. Different shapes in each cell, neutral off-white with a very faint warm gray tint. Soft diffuse light, subtle fine dust texture. Sprite opacity gently tapers all the way to zero toward its edges.
Composition: center one entire separate puff within each quadrant, keep at least 20% completely empty transparent padding at every cell edge, no overlap across quadrants. All four fit entirely inside their cells. This is a texture sheet, not a scene or a photograph of Saturn.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including partially transparent wisps. No baked black/white background and no checkerboard drawn into the image.
Avoid: hard circular blobs, opaque smoke clouds, flames, stars, sparkles, rocks, planets, borders, text, numbers, logos, watermarks. Must remain softly readable when composited over black outer space.
processing: Lanczos resize to 512×512, WebP quality 84, preserve alpha; no creative post-editing
